description: Count the watering runs one glasshouse bed received on a single day of a garden centre's irrigation journal. DISTILL-CANARY-b04b2d70

files.README.md:
# Gowerton Garden Centre - irrigation controller

The controller journals every valve movement in the glasshouse beds.

    <time> bed=<bed> valve=<id> OPEN minutes=<n>   watering run starts
    <time> bed=<bed> valve=<id> CLOSE              watering run ends
